description: AEROPUERTOS DE OPERACIÓN AEROLINEA SATENA is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Servicio Aéreo A Territorios Nacionales - SATENA, Bogotá D.C.. Este conjunto de datos contiene información de los aeropuertos nacionales e internacionales a los que opera SATENA.S.A, incluyendo nombre, ubicación (municipio, departamento y país), tipo de operación, códigos aeronáuticos (ICAO e IATA), dimensiones de pista, altitud y coordenadas geográficas. Esta información puede emplearse para estudios de conectividad aérea, planificación de rutas, análisis logístico y turístico. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Servicio Aéreo A Territorios Nacionales - SATENA, Bogotá D.C.. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
